subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the two people at the stall

745090101.text: After a while, you and Paimon arrive at the Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta booth...

745090102.text: Oh, the Twin Stars of Brilliant Valor! Are you back for more of Lil' Fungi's Fun-Tastic Fiesta?

745090103.text: Ms. Enghiene received orders to return to the Maison Gardiennage, so I'll be playing against you for now!

745090105.text: Paimon was pretty surprised when we met Haniyyah, but you've taken it to the next level! Your outfit is so... Well, you sure are enthusiastic!

745090106.text: And that's a good thing, because I have a lot of work... I need to stay motivated.

745090107.text: And that's why I'll cut my problems down, one clean axe-swing at a time!

745090110.text: Our plan is progressing steadily. Novel events like these attract a lot of attention, and the paper won't miss any promotion opportunities!

745090111.text: We didn't get the most important page, but it's clear that the event's becoming more popular.

745090112.text: That's right. We've seen an increase in ordinary citizens who wanted to give our game a try recently.

745090113.text: Many have been talking about what's the best Fungi team with which to win a round quickly.

745090114.text: I've also heard that people have been looking to play against you two, so they can see how the experts play.
